intro-body: 저희는 리듬 게임, 덱 빌더, 내러티브 호러 등을 만드는 인디 스튜디오입니다. 로드맵은 하나의 타이틀에 국한되지 않으며, 카탈로그, Discord, 그리고 새로운 세계를 병렬로 확장해 나가고 있습니다. 일정은 약속이 아닌 가이드라인입니다.
request-board-lede: Ask for something, vote on what others asked for, and see what we said back.
request-body-placeholder: What are you trying to do, and what stops you today?
request-empty-description: Be the first to ask for something in this category.
request-merged-into: Merged into “{{title}}” — your vote moved with it.
request-new-description: Search the board first — voting on an existing request counts for more than a duplicate.
request-note-placeholder: Shipped and declined requests need a reason. Say it here.
request-note-required: Shipped and declined requests need an official reply.
request-note-too-short: That reply is too short to explain anything.
request-sign-in: Sign in to vote on requests
request-sign-in-hint: Sign in to file a request or vote.
request-title-placeholder: One sentence: what do you want?
